title: Senior Manager - Continuous Improvement and Risk Management
description:
**Contract Type:** Full time, Permanent  
**Location:** Noida  
  
**JOB OVERVIEW**

The Senior Manager – Continuous Improvement and Risk Management will lead the planning, execution, governance, and delivery of projects and transformation initiatives that support organisational objectives. The role will work across multiple business functions to drive accountability, manage stakeholders, and ensure initiatives are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.

The role will also be responsible for continuous improvement and risk management, including identifying process inefficiencies, removing non-value-added activities, developing and implementing improvement action plans, and proactively managing risks, dependencies, and resources. The Manager will play a key role in coordinating strategic initiatives and driving sustainable business transformation across the organisation.

 **ABOUT THE ROLE**

### **Planning & Delivery**

* Lead the end-to-end delivery of organisational initiatives from initiation through to closure.
* Define exercise scope, objectives, deliverables, timelines, and success criteria.
* Develop and maintain detailed plans, document progress towards meeting objectives and schedules.
* Ensure organisations projects are delivered within agreed scope, budget, quality, and timeline constraints.
* Monitor exercise/task performance and implement corrective actions where required.
* Provide project management for the Continuous Improvement activities.
* Provide technical guidance, training or where required, directly investigate, implement and report on business issues.
* Build and maintain effective relationships with project sponsors, business leaders, and key stakeholders.
* Facilitate meetings, workshops, steering committees, and governance forums.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure timely communication of updates.

**Governance & Reporting**

* Establish governance frameworks and reporting mechanisms.
* Prepare regular status reports, dashboards, and executive updates.
* Maintain documentation, including action logs, risk registers, and decision records.
* Ensure compliance with organisational standards and methodologies.

**Risk & Issue Management**

* Identify, assess, and manage risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies.
* Develop mitigation and contingency plans.
* Monitor risk exposure and escalate significant concerns as required.
* Ensure timely resolution of blockers.

**Resource & Financial Management**

* Coordinate resources across functions and teams.
* Monitor budgets and expenditure against approved plans.
* Track resource utilisation and capacity requirements.
* Support financial forecasting and budget management activities.

**Change Management**

* Assess, document, and manage change requests.
* Evaluate impacts on scope, timelines, resources, and budget.
* Support organisational readiness and adoption of new processes or systems.
* Facilitate smooth transition into business-as-usual operations.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to improve methodologies and governance.
* Support the development of CI management capabilities across the organisation.

**ABOUT YOU**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Project Management, Operations, Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline.
* Understanding of lean techniques such as Value Stream Mapping, Process mapping, workflow analysis and PDCA/DMAIC methodologies.
* Experience in leading/project managing individuals & teams and possess bias towards action.
* Experience using statistical analysis tools and methodologies.
* Project Management certification preferred (PMP, PRINCE2, Agile Practitioner, Scrum Master, or equivalent) / Lean Six Sigma Green Belt is desirable but not essential.
* ISO 9001:2015 Internal Auditor, Lead Auditor, or QMS exposure desirable but not essential.
* 6-9 years of project management experience delivering medium to large-scale projects.
* Experience managing multiple stakeholders across varying levels of seniority.
* Demonstrated experience in project planning, governance, reporting, budget management, and risk management.
* Experience within transformation, operational improvement, technology, or business change programmes is desirable.
* Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with the ability to align cross-functional teams around transformation objectives.

**ABOUT US**  
  
Study Group is a leading international education provider that is dedicated and passionate about helping students around the world, creating a brighter future and reaching their full potential. With university partnerships and a variety of face-to-face, online, and hybrid study programmes, we are able to provide students with the resources and guidance they need to succeed. Our global network of offices and university partnerships ensure that students receive the best educational services available. Additionally, our Insendi platform enables us to deliver innovative, accessible, and intuitive digital learning experiences with the most advanced digital tools available.  
  
**ORGANISATIONAL COMPLIANCE**  
  
Study Group is proud of its high standards in safeguarding and recognises its importance in enabling the best possible student experience and outcomes. For successful applicants, the following checks will be conducted- Criminal Background Check (country-specific), x2 References, ID and Right to Work checks as well as Education Verification.  
We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and we strive to create a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of race, gender, religion, nationality, or any other factor. We believe that the best person for the job should be selected based on skills and experience alone. Your information will be kept confidential and stored securely. Please see our Privacy Policy.

title: Service Delivery Director
description:

**Job Summary**
---------------


This role is accountable for driving operational excellence, ensuring client commitments are consistently met, and embedding a culture of continuous improvement across delivery teams. They play a pivotal role in aligning operational performance with strategic business objectives while maintaining a proactive, solution\-focused approach.

------------------------

-----------------

The role requires strong delivery leadership, executive stakeholder engagement, commercial awareness, and the ability to drive complex, multi\-workstream programs to measurable business outcomes.

========================

------------------------------------


* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of complex Transition and Transformation programs across Infrastructure and Applications.
* Manage scope, schedules, budgets, resources, risks, dependencies, milestones, deliverables, and benefits realization.

-------------------


* Lead and motivate geographically distributed, cross\-functional teams.
* Create a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Mentor Project Managers and remove delivery roadblocks.

**Transition \& Transformation Delivery**
-----------------------------------------


* Lead service transitions, modernization initiatives, cloud programs, application transformations, cutovers, migrations, stabilization, and operational readiness.
* Drive measurable service improvements and business value across multi\-vendor environments.
  

**Key Responsibilities (continued)**
====================================


**Commercial, Financial \& Growth Support**
-------------------------------------------


* Manage program budgets, forecasts, resource plans, financial performance, and P\&L considerations.
* Understand and manage Statements of Work, contractual obligations, commercial constructs, and change requests.
* Support regional RFP, RFI, and RFQ responses, solution workshops, effort estimates, staffing plans, and proposal development.

**Digital, Agile \& AI\-Enabled Delivery**
------------------------------------------


* Promote Agile, Waterfall, and Hybrid delivery practices appropriate to the engagement.
* Apply GenAI and automation to improve planning, reporting, governance, risk analysis, knowledge management, and team productivity.
* Stay current with emerging technologies, delivery methods, and industry trends.

**Required Experience \& Knowledge**
====================================


* 20\+ years of Project and Program Management experience, including leadership of large\-scale Transition and Transformation programs.
* Proven experience managing global, cross\-functional teams and multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Strong command of project fundamentals including scope, deliverables, milestones, baselines, critical paths, RAID, change control, financials, and benefits tracking.
* Sound understanding of Infrastructure Services including Data Centre, Cloud, Network, Cyber Security, Digital Workplace, and IT Service Management.
* Understanding of enterprise Applications, ERP and non\-ERP solutions, SDLC, application modernization, and integration programs.
* Industry and domain awareness across diverse enterprise environments.

=============================

Microsoft Project (MPP), Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Office

  

  

**Platforms \& Reporting**

**Ways of Working**

**Qualifications**
==================

Bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline

**PREFERRED**

title: Project Manager - Scrum Master
description:
Project Manager \- Scrum Master
Noida, Uttar Pradesh
**Job Summary**
---------------


The Project Manager will be responsible for managing projects following Agile methodologies. This role involves overseeing project deliverables, coordinating with cross functional teams, and ensuring the successful implementation of projects. The Project Manager will also act as a Scrum Master, facilitating Agile ceremonies and ensuring the team follows Agile practices and principles.
**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


1\. Lead and manage project teams in the successful execution of projects using agile methodologies.
  

2\. Act as a scrum master, facilitate agile ceremonies such as daily standups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
  

3\. Collaborate with stakeholders to define project scope, goals, and deliverables.
  

4\. Monitor project progress, identify and mitigate risks, and ensure timely delivery of project milestones.
  

5\. Implement change management processes to address any scope changes or project deviations.
  

6\. Foster a culture of continuous improvement and agile best practices within the project team.
  

7\. Report project status, issues, and risks to stakeholders and senior management.
**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


1\. Proficient in agile methodologies and experienced in acting as a scrum master.
  

2\. Solid understanding of project management and change management principles.
  

3\. Strong leadership skills to motivate and guide project teams towards successful project delivery.
  

4\. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with stakeholders and team members effectively.
  

5\. Ability to adapt to changing project requirements and priorities in a fast paced environment.
  

6\. Problem\-solving skills to address project challenges and ensure project objectives are met.
**Other Requirements**
----------------------


1\.Agile or Scrum Master certification is preferred.

title: Senior Technical Lead
description:
Senior Technical Lead
Noida, Uttar Pradesh
**Job Summary**
---------------


We are looking for an experienced Pega Technical Architect / Senior CSSA who can design, build, and guide enterprise\-grade Pega applications. The candidate should have strong hands\-on experience in Pega case management, integrations, user interface design — preferably Constellation — security, DevOps, monitoring, and performance optimization.
  

The role requires a strong technical leader who can work closely with customers, business analysts, product owners, architects, and development teams to deliver scalable, maintainable, secure, and cost\-optimized Pega solutions. The candidate should also be aware of the latest Pega platform capabilities such as Pega Blueprint, Process AI, Knowledge Buddy, Pega GenAI Coach, and other AI\-powered features.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


Design and implement Pega applications using best practices, guardrails, reusable components, and enterprise architecture principles.
  

* Own the technical design for case types, workflows, data models, integrations, user interfaces, security model, and background processing.
* Guide and mentor Pega developers in solution design, rule configuration, code quality, guardrail compliance, and troubleshooting.
* Collaborate with customers, business stakeholders, product owners, scrum masters, testers, and other technology teams to translate business requirements into robust Pega solutions.
* Lead technical discussions, design walkthroughs, solution reviews, impact assessments, and architecture review sessions.
* Design and implement Pega case management solutions including stages, steps, processes, assignments, SLAs, routing, correspondence, and exception handling.
* Build and review integrations using REST, SOAP, file listeners, email listeners, queue processors, job schedulers, data pages, and connectors/services.
* Design modern Pega user experiences using Constellation UI, App Studio, views, reusable UI patterns, and responsive design principles.
* Implement Pega security configurations including access groups, roles, privileges, authentication, authorization, data security, and secure integration patterns.
* Support DevOps and release management using Pega Deployment Manager, branch\-based development, CI/CD practices, and deployment governance.
* Monitor application health and performance using Pega Predictive Diagnostic Cloud — PDC, logs, alerts, PAL, Tracer, Clipboard, and other diagnostic tools.
* Perform performance tuning, root cause analysis, technical debt identification, and application optimization.
* Contribute to cost optimization by recommending efficient design patterns, reusable assets, simplified architecture, and optimized use of platform capabilities.
* Support production deployments, go\-live readiness, post\-production validation, and issue resolution.
* Stay current with latest Pega Infinity, Constellation, GenAI, Blueprint, Process AI, Knowledge Buddy, Coach, and related platform capabilities.
* Contribute to reusable assets, accelerators, coding standards, best practices, knowledge sharing, and internal capability building.

Required Technical Skills
  

Core Pega Platform
  

* Strong hands\-on experience in Pega PRPC / Pega Infinity.
* Excellent understanding of Pega case management, case lifecycle design, stages, steps, flows, assignments, SLAs, routing, and correspondence.
* Strong knowledge of rule types such as activities, data transforms, decision rules, when rules, declare expressions, report definitions, data pages, flows, flow actions, and sections/views.
* Good understanding of Pega guardrails, application layering, class structure, ruleset management, circumstancing, and reusable component design.

Pega UI / Constellation
  

* Strong experience in Pega UI design.
* Preferred hands\-on exposure to Pega Constellation UI, App Studio, views, portals, personas, channels, and modern UX design.
* Understanding of traditional UI concepts such as sections, harnesses, skins, dynamic layouts, and Theme Cosmos will be useful for modernization scenarios.

Integrations
  

* Strong experience in designing and implementing integrations using REST, SOAP, connectors, services, data pages, and external systems.
* Good knowledge of integration error handling, data mapping, authentication, retry patterns, and exception management.
* Exposure to file listeners, email listeners, job schedulers, queue processors, and background processing.

Security
  

* Strong understanding of Pega security model including access groups, roles, privileges, access control policies, authentication, authorization, and secure data handling.
* Ability to design secure solutions for enterprise applications involving sensitive or regulated data.

BIX / Reporting / Data
  

* Exposure to Pega BIX for data extraction and downstream reporting.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


Good understanding of report definitions, data pages, data types, data transforms, and data modeling.
  

* Ability to design reporting and audit\-friendly data structures.

DevOps and Monitoring
  

* Exposure to Pega Deployment Manager for DevOps, CI/CD, release orchestration, deployment pipelines, and environment promotion.
* Experience with PDC for application monitoring, alert analysis, performance diagnostics, and proactive issue identification.
* Familiarity with Tracer, Clipboard, PAL, logs, alerts, DB trace, and performance troubleshooting tools.

**Other Requirements**
----------------------
